parent-goal-missing.why: a parent names an existing goal

parent-in-other-stream.why: a parent is a goal in the same stream

child-entry-invalid.why: parent rules run only on valid entries

parent-cycle.why: parent links form a forest; a day goal and a week goal cannot be each other's parents

snapshot-two-revisions.why: a snapshot holds one current revision per record

snapshot-two-revisions-reversed.why: the result does not depend on entry order

parent-removed-in-current-revision.why: a parent resolves only against the current revision

ancestor-parent-missing.why: every goal's parent in the snapshot resolves, not only the child's

ancestor-parent-is-charter.why: a charter holds no goals, so it cannot be a parent
